page_title: Buyer Workflow - Dudhiya Milk Collection App
workflow_guide_subtitle: Everything you need to know about managing your milk collection center with Dudhiya. From adding suppliers to generating reports - we've got you covered!
step1_description: Start by adding dairy farmers to your collection center. Each farmer gets a unique ID and profile where you can store all their important information. This makes tracking and managing collections super easy!
step1_feature1_desc: Save name, phone number, and village
step1_feature2_desc: Unique supplier codes for quick identification
step1_feature3_desc: Edit, update, or search suppliers anytime
step1_feature4_desc: View all past collections and payments
step2_description: Record every milk delivery with accuracy. Choose between Standard and Pro-Rata collection types. The app auto-calculates FAT, SNF, and rates instantly - no manual calculations needed!
step2_feature1_desc: Record collections in seconds with auto-fill
step2_feature2_desc: Choose Standard or Pro-Rata based on your needs
step2_feature3_desc: Instant FAT, SNF, and rate calculations
step2_feature4_desc: Handle morning and evening shifts separately
step3_description: Create professional PDF bills and Excel reports for any date range, specific farmer, or shift. Share them instantly via WhatsApp, email, or print. Keep accurate records for your business and farmers!
step3_feature1_desc: Generate and share individual farmer bills
step3_feature2_desc: Filter by date, farmer, shift, or rate type
step3_feature3_desc: Share via WhatsApp, email, or download
flexible_rate_description: A unique feature designed for collection centers! Record milk collections without worrying about rates upfront. Set rates later when generating reports based on the latest milk prices.
flexible_step1_desc: When farmers bring milk, simply record the quantity, FAT, and SNF values. Leave the rate field empty - no need to know the current milk price!
flexible_step2_desc: Continue recording daily collections. All data is safely stored with the date and farmer details, ready for rate assignment.
flexible_step3_desc: When the new milk rate is announced, generate reports and enter the rate then. The system automatically calculates all pending collections!
flexible_rate_perfect_for: Perfect for when milk rates change frequently or when you need to wait for dairy company's rate announcement before calculating payments.
more_features_subtitle: Additional powerful tools to streamline your collection center operations
wallet_payments_desc: Track farmer balances, record payments, and generate transparent financial reports. Know exactly how much each farmer is owed.
shift_management_desc: Handle morning (AM) and evening (PM) shifts separately with different rates. Perfect for centers with multiple collection times.
milk_calculator_desc: Built-in calculator to instantly compute milk value based on FAT, SNF, and volume. No external calculator needed!
cloud_backup_desc: All your data is securely backed up to the cloud. Never lose your records even if you switch devices.
smart_reminders_desc: Get notifications for pending payments, low inventory, or scheduled collections. Stay on top of your business.
analytics_dashboard_desc: View collection trends, top suppliers, and daily summaries. Make data-driven decisions for your center.
ready_transform_title: Ready to Transform Your Collection Center?
ready_transform_subtitle: Join thousands of collection centers across India using Dudhiya to streamline their milk collection operations. Start your digital journey today!
